title: 第七章 局势复杂第八章 就这
content_zh:
而在李剑锋眼里，武书是被赵焚星所看好的。先前也是试探性的与武书交手，深知武书还是有些实力的。
李剑锋还是客气的拱手道，“同为堃国后辈娇子，今日能够相遇，必然是我们有缘分。在下李剑锋，不知朋友尊姓大名。”
在武书看来，刚刚还一口一个本大爷呢？简单一次交手后，就朋友了吗？
这李剑锋看上去五大三粗，性格暴烈，实则还是一个有脑子的人。这货，说不好，实力上还远不如此？毕竟似乎认识赵焚星。
武书也是不想啰嗦，随便想了个名字道，“舒武”
舒武这个名字，李剑锋还真是没听过。
就算这样，李剑锋依旧咧嘴大笑道，“误会，先前发生的一切都是误会。舒武兄弟，不是兄弟说你，夜行兽这种神兽级珍品坐骑，你真不该随手丢掉。舒武兄弟，实不相瞒，在见你将夜行兽丢下后，我的心中那叫一片哀嚎啊？在我们堃国，能被称作强者的人，还是有不少的。可这些人中，若是能够有一人拥有夜行兽作伴，估摸着那人做梦都能笑醒。”
什么玩意？
夜行兽在修行界也这么受欢迎吗？拥有夜行兽简直就像拥有了高贵身份一般。
可是在武书看来，夜行兽无非是比驴子和马好看那么一点，又没有其他用处。
李剑锋又道，“也是担心夜行兽在山脉中受到散落的战兽威胁，在没有告知舒武兄弟的情况下，在下私自将夜行兽带上了。”
李剑锋继续道，“小白，你们出来吧？”
一头狗子大小的虎子，一匹山羊大小的夜行兽便是从林中走出。
整个过程下来，夜行兽眼神冰冷，简直想将武书活吞了。
武书不由感到头大，先前说了夜行兽的坏话，这货肯定记仇了，而今天又遇到了李剑锋这种多管闲事的人。
同时，武书心中也是困惑的。
奇了怪了，难道赵焚星与李剑锋真的关系匪浅？夜行兽怎么会愿意跟着李剑锋而来，难道李剑锋的坐骑小白，也是头实力非凡的灵兽吗？
想到这些，武书很是心烦。本想安静寻个天地灵气充足的地方修炼，现在眼前却是多了这么一位爱管闲事的家伙。武书可不想和李剑锋纠缠在一起，便是看向夜行兽平静道，“夜行兽，过来吧？我带你到其他地方转转，这次绝不会将你独自丢下了。”
见武书想走，且一副不是很情愿带上夜行兽的样子。李剑锋觉得，眼前的一切若是被他人撞上，李剑锋相信很多人都想与武书在实力上分个高下，那些人一定很想知道，和武书比，他们究竟差在哪里。
而夜行兽虽然很排斥武书说的话，但却还是走到武书身后。

见武书想要独自离开，李剑锋一副老气横秋的道，“舒武，猜的没错的话，你此次前来巨象山脉，是为了修炼，对吧？”
魔族入侵巨象山脉的消息，是被完全封锁的。李剑锋相信，武书肯定是不知道的。
李剑锋又道，“近来巨象山脉之中事情繁杂，依我之意，我们最好同行。若是真遇上了突变，至少你我联手，还是有机会逃生的？”
武书心中是执意独行的。
而灵机一动，武书想到他现在手头最短缺的就是灵石，武书平静道，“李兄，这怕是不好吧？偌大的巨象山脉，以你我的实力，只要不进入山脉深处，自保能力还是有的。当然了，若是李兄执意想找个强力的打手跟班，十块灵石，不能再少了。”
李剑锋倒是没想到，想要与武书同行，武书会张口向他索要灵石。
十块灵石？
十块下品灵石，还不算什么？李剑锋身上就有数十块，可若是中品灵石，李剑锋身上就那么几块。
又以赵焚星的身份联想，这货要的若是十块传说中的上品灵石，即便将自己的家底搬空，估计也就能够兑换一只手能够数的过来的数。
这简直是狮子大开口。
content_en:
In Li Jianfeng's eyes, Wu Shu was favored by Zhao Fenxing. I had tentatively fought against Wu Shu before, knowing that Wu Shu still had some strength.
Li Jianfeng still politely held up his hands and said, "We are both sweet sons of the Kun Kingdom. We must be destined to meet each other today. I'm Li Jianfeng, I don't know the name of my friend."
From Wu Shu's point of view, why was he just talking like an old man? After a simple encounter, are we friends?
This Li Jianfeng looks rough and rough, with a violent personality, but in fact he is still a thoughtful person. This guy, it’s hard to say, is far from that in terms of strength? After all, he seemed to know Zhao Fenxing.
Wu Shu didn't want to be verbose, so he casually thought of a name and said, "Shu Wu."
Li Jianfeng had never heard of the name Shu Wu.
Even so, Li Jianfeng still grinned and said, "Misunderstanding, everything that happened before was just a misunderstanding. Brother Shu Wu, I am not telling you, you really shouldn't throw away a precious beast-level mount like the Nightwalker. Brother Shu Wu, to be honest, in When I saw you leaving the Night Beast behind, I felt a wail in my heart. In our country, there are still many people who can be called strong. But if one of these people could have a Night Beast as a companion, I guess that person would be able to laugh out of his dreams."
What the hell?
Are nocturnal beasts so popular in the spiritual world? Owning a night beast is like having a noble status.
But in Wu Shu's opinion, nocturnal beasts are just a little prettier than donkeys and horses, and have no other uses.
Li Jianfeng added, "I was also worried that the Night Beast would be threatened by the scattered war beasts in the mountains, so I secretly took the Night Beast with me without informing Brother Shu Wu."
Li Jianfeng continued, "Xiaobai, can you come out?"
A tiger the size of a dog and a nocturnal beast the size of a goat walked out of the forest.
After the whole process, Nightwalker's eyes were cold and he almost wanted to eat Wu Shu alive.
Wu Shu couldn't help but feel a headache. He said bad things about Night Beast before, so he must have a grudge, and today he met a nosy person like Li Jianfeng again.
At the same time, Wu Shu was also confused.
This is strange. Could it be that Zhao Fenxing and Li Jianfeng really have a close relationship? How could the Night Beast be willing to follow Li Jianfeng? Could it be that Li Jianfeng's mount Xiaobai was also an extraordinary spiritual beast?
Thinking of this, Wu Shu was very upset. I wanted to quietly find a place with enough spiritual energy to practice, but now I have such a nosy guy in front of me. Wu Shu didn't want to get entangled with Li Jianfeng, so he looked at Night Beast and said calmly, "Night Beast, come here? I will take you to other places and I will never leave you alone this time."
Seeing that Wu Shu wanted to leave, he seemed reluctant to take the night beast with him. Li Jianfeng felt that if everything in front of him was bumped into by others, Li Jianfeng believed that many people would want to compete with Wu Shu in terms of strength. Those people must want to know where they are compared with Wu Shu.
Although the night beast was very repulsive to what Wu Shu said, it still walked behind Wu Shu.
Seeing that Wu Shu wanted to leave alone, Li Jianfeng said in an old-fashioned way, "Shu Wu, if your guess is correct, you came to the Giant Elephant Mountains this time to practice, right?"
News of the demon invasion of the Giant Elephant Mountains was completely blocked. Li Jianfeng believed that Wu Shu must not know.
Li Jianfeng added, "Things have been complicated in the Giant Elephant Mountains recently. According to my opinion, it's best for us to go together. If we really encounter a sudden change, at least if you and I work together, we still have a chance to escape?"
Wu Shu was determined to go it alone.
Then an idea struck Wu Shu, who thought that what he was most short of now was spirit stones. Wu Shu said calmly, "Brother Li, I'm afraid this is not good, right? With the strength of you and me in the huge Giant Elephant Mountains, as long as we don't enter the depths of the mountains, we still have the ability to protect ourselves. Of course, if Brother Li insists on finding a powerful thug to follow him,Ban, ten spiritual stones, no more. "
Li Jianfeng did not expect that if he wanted to go with Wu Shu, Wu Shu would ask him for the spirit stone.
Ten spiritual stones?
Ten low-grade spiritual stones, what's nothing? Li Jianfeng has dozens of pieces on his body, but if it is a middle-grade spiritual stone, Li Jianfeng only has a few pieces on his body.
Thinking about Zhao Fenxing's identity, if what this guy wants is ten pieces of legendary high-grade spiritual stones, even if he empties his entire family, he will probably be able to exchange them for a number that can be counted on one hand.
This is simply a lion's mouth.
